# Cargo.toml for a web service
# This configuration defines the project metadata and dependencies.

[package]
name = "api-gateway"
version = "2.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "High-performance API gateway with rate limiting and auth"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"

# Core dependencies for the web framework
[dependencies]

tracing = "0.1"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", features = ["env-filter", "json"] }

# Database and caching
[dependencies.sqlx]
version = "0.7"
features = ["runtime-tokio", "postgres", "uuid", "chrono", "migrate"]

[dependencies.redis]
version = "0.25"
features = ["tokio-comp", "connection-manager"]

# Authentication
jsonwebtoken = "9.3"

# Rate limiting and metrics
governor = "0.6"

[dev-dependencies]

# Build profiles
[profile.release]
